description: The definition of the average cumulative average residual itself is only cited as support, never stated as a unit: ACAR_{W,t} is the mean across the N replications of CAR_{W,n,t}, and every headline number in the paper -- including the 24.6% thirty-six-month difference -- is a value of this statistic. A reader with the units cannot say what ACAR denotes.
